generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per uploaded e-Tender documents

technicalCriterionList.description: 1)Any individual, Firm / Agency, Partnership firm, Company, having Class-III Contractor Registered with BDA, NH, PWD, CPWD, Railways, MES, any other Government organization or Public sector undertaking having suitable technical, financial and managerial capabilities are eligible to apply. Certificate to be uploaded duly signed by the competent authority.

2)Forest Contractor Registration certificate As per Article 72 of the Karnataka Forest Code 1976 for the year 2026-27 Registration should be done in the office of the Deputy Conservator of Forests, TA to Conservator of Forests, Working Plan, Dharwad.
3)The tenderer should have minimum 2 years of Experience in last 5 year in survey work.

4)After completion of the Survey & Demarcation Work, the respective contractor is responsible for 1 year, if there are any disputes arise, regarding this contractor instructed to upload undertaking letter compulsorily.

5)The tenderer, as an employer should have at least 3 surveyors with Civil engineering/Diploma in survey/JOC Survey/ITI Survey Qualification and they should have 3 years of experience in surveying. It is also required to produce relevant records of payment to such engaged surveyors and those payment are necessarily been tally with the audited balance sheet.
6)The tenderer should enclose the list of survey equipments owned/hired/leased with him/her.

7)Last Two years of experience certificate for having carried out survey and demarcation works to the magnitude of Rs. 50 Lakhs obtained by the officer not below the Rank of Deputy Conservator of Forests should be enclosed.
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Experience Certificate for having carried out Survey & Demarcation Works

technicalCriterionList.description: 8)Qualification information and Document for forestry work-experience (Clause 3.1.b) as per formats given in Format-01
9)Copy of Aadhar Card, Copy of PAN and Permanent Address

10)To qualify for the award of this contract, each Tenderer in his/her/its name should have in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26). i) Achieved in at least three financial years a minimum financial turnover (in works such as survey using Chain & Compass latest GPS devices and works including cement concrete works) of e-Tender Amount/ Estimate Amount certified by a chartered accountant. ii) Satisfactory completion, as a prime contractor for at least one similar nature of work (as mentioned above) for an amount of the 50% of e-Tender Amount/ Estimate Amount. Duly certified by the competent authority.
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Financial Turnover (in works such as Survey & Demarcation)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Financial Turnover (in works such as Survey & Demarcation)

(Credit lines / Letter of Credit / Certificates) from banks, for meeting the fund requirement etc. A scanned copy of the same shall be attached along with the Technical bid, failing which the bids will not be considered.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: SURVEY & DEMARCATION WORK OF BLOCK AND COMPARTMENT FOREST BOUNDARY, PROVIDING, FIXING AND PAINTING TO RCC PILLARS WORKS IN BARCHI, BHAGAWATI, HALIYAL & SAMBRANI RANGES OF HALIYAL DIVISION DURING THE YEAR 2026-27(Block&Compartment-03).

itemList.description: Survey & Demarcation of Forest/ Block/ Compartment boundary including clearing of jungle growth to a width of 2 meters by engaging a gang of following persons. In area with thick under growth. 3 meters wide clearance Mazdoor requirement for 1 Km = 21 / 0.8 Km = 26.25.
Construction of labour shed using locally available forest material 10 unskilled heavy mazdoors(One shed for every 10 Kms)

Fixing the reference point / bench mark on the ground with reference to the map and surveying the tie lines for measuring the accuracy of the survey work done. @ 10% of  rate provided for Item No.101(a). (ii)  In areas with Thick under growth
Engaging one qualified Surveyor @ one manday for 0.80 Km of work.
Engaging one qualified Draughtsman @ one manday for 0.80 Km of work.

Purchase of Stationery like Tracing sheets, Graph sheets, Note Books, Files, Xeroxing, Scanning of Forests maps, Colour Printing of Maps, Auto Cad work of preparation of surveyed maps, Villages maps Preparation & per Village 05 Nos. Colour Xerox, Correction of maps, Typing of GPS readings & Annexure, Multiplication of records, Soft copy preparation etc.

Construction of Forest Boundary Demarcation Pillar of total height of 1.7 m (including Bed of 0.80m x 0.80m x 0.075m) having column of total height 1.0m with 0.35m x 0.35m at the bottom and 0.25m x 0.25m at the top (above footing), Pyramidal shaped Cap of height 0.05m and base of 0.25m x 0.25m, Footing of 0.5mx0.5mx0.525m Portion below ground and 0.5m x 0.5m x 0.05 m footing above the ground with the following specifications in Forest Boundary.
Scrutiny & Documentations charges and Miscellaneous Expenditure, etc.
